description: Several large, colorful plastic building blocks are spread out on the bed in front of the person. The left hand reaches in to pick up and reposition a blue block, while the right hand slides a white block toward it, then brings a long green block in to connect alongside; the right hand adds another blue block and the left hand places a pink block on top, followed by stacking a yellow block above it, and finally the right hand lifts and positions a green block onto the growing stack, releasing it in place.
